name: Conduit
long_description:
Conduit is the leading AI agent platform for hospitality operations.

Operators can create, test, and run AI agents on Conduit's harness purpose built for hospitality. On-brand agents handles the full guest journey, converting inquiries into bookings and driving upsell revenue, then runs internal operations and surfaces insights for leadership. All connected to the systems operators already use. 

Trusted by over 1000+ global hospitality brands across 120+ countries.

launches.title: Conduit: Conversational AI agents for housing and hospitality
launches.tagline: AI agents that transform conversations into a source of conversions, revenue, and cost savings—without compromising on high-quality support.
launches.body:
Customer conversations are the backbone of every business. Conduit deploys AI agents that transform conversations into a source of conversions, revenue, and cost savings—without compromising on high-quality support.

We’re starting in housing and hospitality, where communication _is_ the operation. Whether it’s leasing, scheduling, or support, every core operation in housing and hospitality starts with a conversation.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89389&key=user_uploads/1073248/075a7605-c68b-411c-a5b4-994a1e5b63fc)

With the full context of your business, Conduit can talk to customers over text and voice like your best employee—responsive, consistent, and sharp, while knowing exactly when to bring in a human. And they don’t just answer questions, they drive conversations toward outcomes that matter.

Conduit works autonomously, but never in the dark. We give you full visibility into performance, with the ability to inspect, adjust, and improve how agents operate, so you can stay hands-off without losing control. AI is only as powerful as your ability to understand and direct it. We give you both.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89389&key=user_uploads/1073248/2eb14601-fde1-4e92-9193-d9cd9489fa22)

Level up your operation with Conduit—the conversational backbone of AI-forward companies.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=89389&key=user_uploads/1073248/83805d2f-2aea-407a-80c9-2f140151512d)

launches.title: 🏠 HostAI - The operating system for vacation rentals
launches.tagline: We provide an all-in-one platform that helps vacation rental managers deliver 5-star guest experiences at scale.
launches.body:
**Tl;dr:** HostAI streamlines guest services, team management, maintenance, and marketing for vacation rental managers. We remove the complexity of management so managers can focus on providing great hospitality. 

Hi everyone, we’re Punn and Cole, the founders of [HostAI](https://www.hostai.app/).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78716&key=user_uploads/1382533/4b1e29ef-79e7-4bac-9b2c-e335b5377539)

[Punn:](https://www.linkedin.com/in/punnkam/) Ex-Google engineer and proptech builder.

[Cole:](https://www.linkedin.com/in/colerubin/) Vacation rental manager and real estate developer. 

❌ **Problem:** Vacation rental management is hard

It’s like operating 50 different hotel rooms spread across an entire region. Each property requires its own processes, rules, and team members. Managers use 5-10 different third-party apps to manage everything effectively.

A fragmented tech stack creates multiple failure points for something to get missed, which can negatively impact the guest experience (i.e. the door code didn’t get updated before their check-in).

✅ **Our Solution:** Compound Software

HostAI aggregates information and builds native tools that make managing easier. We also provide modern integrations that enable managers to build workflows to the tools they already use (i.e. Slack or Notion).

Our main features include: 

* **Guest communication:** Handle phone calls and messaging in one place
* **Payroll and Compliance:** Pay team members and manage permits
* **Maintenance management:** Ticketing automation and assignment with AI
* **Loyalty programs:** Encourage rebookings and build a boutique travel brand
* **IoT integrations:** Seamless communication with your hardware (i.e. door locks & thermostats)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78716&key=user_uploads/1382533/26e19b6f-8226-486f-9955-67996aa3ff60)

**🚀Ask**

1. Connect us to vacation rental managers or hosts ([cole@hostai.app](mailto:cole@hostai.app))
2. Next time you stay in an Airbnb or VRBO message your host our website ([hostai.app](https://hostai.app))
